_source: CBP ruling N331047 (2 Mar 2023), scenario one: Chinese copper wire insulated and shielded into cables in Malaysia, cut, terminated and assembled in China. Scenario three of the same ruling: Malaysian copper wire: CBP held Malaysia. The ruling's holding names no origin for scenario one; the engine predicts it. In the selection pool; excluded. Ribbon cables are left out for brevity.

product.name: YV3 paddle card to silver cable assembly (part number 2358571-3)
product.description: A cable assembly used to connect and transmit data between a motherboard and network card within a network server. It comprises high-speed data cables, ribbon cables, and low-speed power cables bound together and terminated with specialized terminal connectors and connection printed circuit boards (PCBs).

components.name: High-speed data cable (insulated wire with mylar tape shield, two copper drain wires, and outer tape)
Low-speed power cables (three insulated copper wires)

operations.name: Insulate copper wire, wrap with mylar tape shield, twist two copper drain wires around shielded wire, and coat in tape to create high-speed data cable
Insulate copper wire to create three low-speed power cables
Cut individual cables to length and cut ends
Solder cable ends onto connection Printed Circuit Board (PCB)
Assemble molded pieces for connectors on each end
Tape cables together and package finished cable assemblies for export
